errorCodes.meaning: The member DID is a protected account — a rootAdmin account — and the requester is not a rootAdmin. Nothing changed.
The member DID has no account at this mediator, so it has no epoch to advance.
The request names an epoch later than the member DID's current one. `details.currentEpoch` carries the epoch in force; send it.
The member DID's record changed under concurrent writes too many times for the epoch advance to be committed. Nothing changed; send the request again.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

MuxDid.description: A DID, carried verbatim and compared by exact string equality. Unlike the messaging family's `Vid`, never a hash: the mediator resolves it to verify a statement signed by it. For a member DID reached over TSP, the TSP VID is the DID itself.
MuxDid.title: MuxDid

Response.description: The success response to a messaging/mux/admin-revoke-all request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/mux/admin-revoke-all/0.1#response.

epoch.description: The member DID's epoch now in force; a new grant must carry it.

epochAdvanced.description: False when the epoch named in the request had already been voided, so nothing changed.

revokedGrants.description: How many grants that were active this request moved to `epochRevoked`.

schema.description: An administrator advances a member DID's epoch at the mediator, voiding every grant on it at once and ending its session attaches, without the member's signature. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

did.description: The member DID whose epoch is advanced.

epoch.description: The epoch being voided: the member DID's current one, as messaging/mux/admin-list with `member` reports it.
